title: A 1,000-mile cloud on Mars may reveal physics never seen in nature
summary: Since it was first recorded by a probe in 2018, scientists have been unable to find a plausible explanation for the existence of this cloud, often referred to as the Arsia Mons Elongated Cloud (AMEC).
